name: Sambandam Spinning Mills Ltd
about: Sambandam Spinning Mills Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing cotton and synthetic yarn and fabric. [1]
keyPoints:
Product Portfolio[1]
1. Organic and Certified Yarns: GOTS, OCS, GRS, OEKO-Tex certified.
2. Specialized Yarns: Combed Gassed Mercerized Yarn, Compact Yarn, Gassed Yarn, Fancy Slub Yarn.
3. Variety Yarns: Multi Count / Multi Slub Yarn, Elitwist Yarn, Core Spun Yarns, Recycled Fibre Yarn.
4. Dope Dyed Yarns: VSF / Modal Yarns.
5. Melange Yarns and Fabrics.
